status: fixed before new assignment computation, training, or any E20 GT evaluation
scene: D-NeRF jumpingjacks, E19 frozen baseline and trajectories
question: Can fit-only short-window reassignment reduce distribution distortion or improve held-out render quality at fixed K, and does full covariance distance beat position-only distance?
inputs: Reuse E19 teacher N24985 and K9276 fixed assignment, teacher-states200, mean-states200, source SH/opacity and one seed42 view order. Hash-lock all inputs.
time_split: E19 even-rank 0..198 plus endpoint199 fit101; odd ranks1..197 holdout99. Each window decision uses only fit indices in that window. Teacher was trained on all200 times.
max_switch_count_rule: round(0.02*N_source), at most this many source IDs per five-time window; never empty a group. Actual count and transitions reported.
assignment_method: Start each window from previous window labels (first window E19 shared labels). Compare source fit-time trajectory to E19 fixed representative centroid trajectory. Candidate target is nearest fixed slot using either full xyz+covFrob squared features or xyz-only squared features. Rank positive per-source cost reduction times fixed normalized source opacity, stable source-index tie break. Greedily accept up to cap while keeping every old group nonempty. Apply chosen labels to all five times; recompute weighted xyz+full-covariance barycenters per time. Slot IDs, representative source IDs, K, SH/opacity parameterization fixed. Single sequential pass, no GT, no iterative per-frame oracle.
appearance: Reuse E19 frozen fixed mean beta0 checkpoint; two new windowed arms start from identical zero SH/logit residuals and fresh Adam, E19 rates, same 20 sequential seed42 fit101 view permutations, native400 full-teacher pixel loss 0.8L1+0.2(1-SSIM), 2020 updates each. No LPIPS training term.
evaluation: Freeze both new checkpoints before any GT read. Evaluate 20 official GT views800, all200 teacher views400, fixed-camera256 temporal residual, fit/holdout full CTD proxy, label switch/churn and group occupancy. Compare with immutable E19 fixed control and check reproduced metrics.
scope: Exploratory second-scene offline window assignment diagnostic after E19 GT has been seen. Teacher-derived states also aggregate holdout geometry as in E19; holdout is only for assignment/appearance fitting. No online inference, learned deformation, adaptive K, full OT plan, split/merge or physical mass.
decision: No metric-based tuning of window length/cap. Report improvement or failure, especially render/temporal tradeoff and full-cost vs position-only; a new scene is required for any method claim.
storage: All files under owner /data3/store1 root; refuse overwrite; >5GiB free guard; no video bulk.
